items.title: Scot Prem latest: Rangers sign Penrice on season-long loan
Tranmere 2-0 Shrewsbury
items.description: Tranmere Rovers got their League Two campaign off to the perfect start with a 2-0 victory over Shrewsbury Town.

items.title: Northampton 0-0 Swindon
items.description: Northampton and Swindon started the new League Two season by playing out a goalless draw at Sixfields.

items.title: Grimsby 1-0 Exeter
items.description: Grimsby got off to a winning start at the expense of newly-relegated Exeter with a tightly-contested 1-0 triumph at Blundell Park.

items.title: Cheltenham 2-1 Rotherham
items.description: A debut strike from Leicester loanee Jake Evans sealed a 2-1 home win for Cheltenham over Rotherham.

items.title: Swansea strike back to win at Stoke
items.description: Super-sub Adam Idah snatched the winner with his first touch of the game as Swansea bravely battled back from a goal down to stun Stoke 2-1.

items.title: Aston Villa latest: Villa working on Suzuki deal - plunging Martinez future into doubt
England's Givens breaks LET duck at 210th attempt as rival's ball gets stuck in tree
items.description: England's Eleanor Givens won her first Ladies European Tour title at the 210th attempt with a one-shot victory at the VP Bank Swiss Ladies Open.

items.title: Newcastle change shirts during first half of friendly
items.description: Newcastle United change shirts in the first half of their pre-season friendly against Bayer Leverkusen.

items.title: Bolton beat Preston for first Championship win since 2019
items.description: Sam Dalby and Thierry Gale scored first-half goals as Bolton beat Preston 2-1 to record their first Sky Bet Championship win since March 2019.

items.title: Oxford 2-2 MK Dons
items.description: Ciaron Brown turned in a Gatlin O'Donkor cross deep into stoppage time to earn relegated Oxford United a 2-2 draw against newly-promoted MK Dons at the Kassam Stadium.

items.title: Reading 3-4 Luton
items.description: Substitute Gideon Kodua scrambled home a stoppage-time winner for Luton as they came from behind to snatch a 4-3 victory at Reading.
